description_en: Create an integration pipeline/unstructured workflow task
description_zh: 创建集成管道/非结构化工作流任务
kebab_example: aliyun dataphin-public create-pipeline --op-tenant-id 30001011 --context ProjectId=123 Env=DEV --create-command '{"ScheduleConfig":"cronExpression_:_0_0_0_0_0_0","Comment":"comment","PipelineConfig":{"Steps":[{"PluginConfig":"example-string","StepType":"input","StepName":"mysql_reader","IsDistribute":true,"Key":"mysqlinput"}],"Hops":[{"Target":"odps_writer","SendTo":true,"Source":"mysql_reader"}]},"NodeInfo":{"NodeName":"test","NodeId":"n_123","PipelineId":123,"FileId":123,"Directory":"/"},"PipelineType":0,"Mode":"PIPELINE","Submit":true,"PipelineJson":"example-string","Settings":"example-string"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipeline

fields.help_en: Project ID to which the integration pipeline/workflow task belongs
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流任务所属项目ID
fields.name: project_id

fields.help_en: Current operating environment: DEV indicates the development environment, PROD indicates the production environment (for workflows, only PROD is currently supported)
fields.help_zh: 当前操作环境env：DEV-表示操作开发环境，PROD-表示操作生产环境（对于工作流，目前仅支持PROD）
fields.name: env

fields.help_en: Scheduling configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString method
fields.help_zh: 调度配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAScheduleConfig#toJsonString方法
fields.name: schedule_config

element_fields.help_en: Specific component configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class: subclasses of com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig (for workflow operators, use com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig) and their toJsonString method. Developers should inherit this component/operator configuration class and implement the corresponding component/operator configuration. Each component/operator configuration has the same structure as the task configuration created on the Dataphin page
element_fields.help_zh: 具体组件配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig（工作流算子则为com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.unstructured.BaseOAUnstructuredNeuronConfig）相关子类的toJsonString方法。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与Dataphin页面创建的任务配置结构相同
element_fields.name: plugin_config

element_fields.help_en: Component type: input indicates an input component, output indicates an output component, transfrom indicates a transform component, process indicates a flow control component. For workflow tasks, this indicates the operator type, such as image for image, text for text. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType. Developers should inherit this component/operator configuration class and implement the corresponding component/operator configuration. Each component/operator configuration has the same structure as the configuration created on the Dataphin page
element_fields.help_zh: 组件类型：input-表示输入组件，output-表示输出组件，transfrom-表示转换组件，process-表示流程控制组件，对于工作流任务则表示算子类型，例如：image-图片，text-文本。参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepType。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与Dataphin页面创建的配置结构相同
element_fields.name: step_type

element_fields.help_en: Step name. Step names must be unique within the same pipeline task
element_fields.help_zh: 步骤名称，在同一个管道任务所有步骤名称不能重复
element_fields.name: step_name

element_fields.help_en:
Indicates the data distribution method when the current component has multiple downstream components:
true indicates that data from the current component is sent to all downstream components in a round-robin manner. For example, if the current component has 100 records and two downstream components, each downstream component receives 50 records. The default value is true.
false indicates that data from the current component is sent in full to all downstream components. For example, if the current component has 100 records and two downstream components, both downstream components receive all 100 records.
For workflow tasks, this value can be ignored
element_fields.help_zh:
用于表示当前组件有多个下游组件时当前组件数据的分发方式：
true-表示当前组件的数据轮流发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有100条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游各有50条数据，默认为true，
false-表示当前组件的数据全量发送到所有下游，例如当前组件有100条数据，有两个下游，则两个下游都有100条数据。
如果为工作流任务，则无需关注此值
element_fields.name: is_distribute

element_fields.help_en: Plugin/operator ID. Each plugin/operator has a unique identifier. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey. Developers should inherit this component/operator configuration class and implement the corresponding component/operator configuration. Each component/operator configuration has the same structure as the configuration created on the Dataphin page
element_fields.help_zh: 插件ID，每个插件/算子都有唯一的标志，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.plugin.OABasePluginConfig#stepKey。开发者应继承该组件/算子配置类，实现相应组件/算子配置，每个组件/算子配置与Dataphin页面创建的配置结构相同
element_fields.name: key

fields.help_en: Component/operator configuration: contains detailed configuration of all components/operators used
fields.help_zh: 组件/算子配置：包含所有用到的组件/算子详细配置
fields.name: steps

element_fields.help_en:
For conditional distribution components, set to true when the downstream condition is true, otherwise set to false.
For workflow tasks, this can be ignored
element_fields.help_zh:
针对条件分发组件，连接下游条件为true时设置为true，否则设置为false。
如果为工作流任务，则无需关注
element_fields.name: send_to

fields.help_en: DAG (directed acyclic graph) link configuration: describes the connections between all components/operators
fields.help_zh: DAG有向无环图链接配置：描述所有组件/算子的连接关系
fields.name: hops

fields.help_zh: 集成管道组件/工作流算子配置
fields.name: pipeline_config

fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流 任务名称
fields.name: node_name

fields.help_en: Scheduling node ID of the pipeline/workflow task. Leave empty for initial creation. When updating a pipeline/workflow task, at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId must be specified
fields.help_zh: 管道/工作流 任务调度节点ID，首次创建为空，更新管道/工作流 任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en: Pipeline/workflow task ID. Leave empty for initial creation. When updating a pipeline/workflow task, at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId must be specified
fields.help_zh: 管道/工作流 任务ID，首次创建为空，更新管道/工作流任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: pipeline_id

fields.help_en: Pipeline/workflow file ID. Leave empty for initial creation. When updating a pipeline/workflow task, at least one of pipelineId, fileId, or nodeId must be specified
fields.help_zh: 管道/工作流 文件ID，首次创建为空，更新管道/工作流 任务时，pipelineId、fileId、nodeId至少配置一个
fields.name: file_id

fields.help_en: Directory of the integration pipeline/workflow task node (defaults to root directory). The directory must exist. If it does not exist, call the relevant API to create a directory of type offlinePipeline (or unstructuredPipeline for workflows)
fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流任务节点目录（默认为根目录），该目录必须存在，如若不存在，则需要调用相关接口创建类型为offlinePipeline（工作流则为unstructuredPipeline）的目录
fields.name: directory

fields.help_zh: 集成管道/工作流 任务基本信息
fields.name: node_info

fields.help_en: Task type: 0 indicates offline integration (default), 1 indicates real-time integration, 14 indicates a workflow task
fields.help_zh: 任务类型：0-表示离线集成（默认），1-表示实时集成，14-表示离线工作流任务，15-表示实时工作流
fields.name: pipeline_type

fields.help_en:
Integration pipeline configuration mode: PIPELINE indicates pipeline mode (default), JSON indicates script mode.
For workflows, this can be ignored
fields.help_zh:
集成管道配置模式：PIPELINE-表示管道模式（默认），JSON-表示脚本模式。
如果为工作流，则无需关注
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: Whether to submit. Submitted by default
fields.name: submit

fields.help_en:
In script mode: integration pipeline configuration (in JSON string format).
Workflow tasks do not support script mode
fields.help_zh:
脚本模式下：集成管道配置（json字符串格式）。
工作流任务不支持脚本模式
fields.name: pipeline_json

fields.help_en: Channel configuration in JSON string format. Refer to the utility class: com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString method
fields.help_zh: 通道配置，格式为JSON字符串，参考工具类：com.alibaba.dataphin.pipeline.common.facade.openapi.model.OAPipelineSetting#toJsonString方法
fields.name: settings

parameters.help_zh: 创建管道/工作流任务配置
parameters.name: create_command
